## Boxes with Arrows

Use arrows to point from annotation boxes to specific elements on your slides.

:::{.fragment}
This is **important content** that needs explanation.
:::

{{< hovering-annotation 
  annotation="Not much of an explanation, really." 
  box-x="40" 
  box-y="45" 
  head-x="30" 
  head-y="37" 
  annotation-width="35%" 
  color="1" 
>}}

{{< hovering-annotation 
  annotation="Place the annotation box in a specific location by setting `box-x` and `box-y` coordinates." 
  box-x="50" 
  box-y="68" 
  head-x="40" 
  head-y="45" 
  arrow-offset="10px"
  annotation-width="35%" 
  color="2" 
>}}

{{< hovering-annotation 
  annotation="Arrows point to the location set by `head-x` and `head-y` coordinates." 
  box-x="0" 
  box-y="68" 
  head-x="30" 
  head-y="37"
  arrow-offset="10px"
  annotation-width="35%" 
  color="3"
>}}


## Boxes Without Arrows

Omit `head-x` and `head-y` to create floating notes without arrows.

:::{.fragment}
Some content that doesn't need precise pointing.
:::

{{< hovering-annotation 
  annotation="This is a general note that doesn't point to anything specific. Perfect for commentary or reminders." 
  box-x="20" 
  box-y="65" 
  annotation-width="40%" 
  color="3" 
>}}

## Highlighting with Marks

Combine annotations with highlighted text using Quarto's [`.mark`-spans]{.mark style="background-color:var(--brand-annotation-color-4)"} or the {{< mark "`{{ < mark > }}` shortcode" color="4" >}} and the same brand colors.

:::{.fragment}
The extension integrates with Quarto's brand color system.
:::

{{< hovering-annotation 
  annotation="Visually connect annotations to specific text or elements." 
  box-x="20" 
  box-y="65" 
  annotation-width="40%" 
  color="4" 
  fragment="false" 
>}}

## Boxes with Mark Indicators

Or place semi-transparent markers freely anywhere on the slide to highlight specific points.


{{< hovering-annotation 
  annotation="The circular marker shows exactly where you're pointing. Customize size and opacity." 
  box-x="50" 
  box-y="60" 
  mark-x="30" 
  mark-y="20" 
  mark-width="3em" 
  mark-height="3em" 
  mark-opacity="0.4" 
  annotation-width="35%" 
  color="5" 
>}}

## Customization Options

- **Colors:** Use brand colors (1-9) or hex codes
- **Sizing:** Control `annotation-width`, `mark-width`, `mark-height`
- **Opacity:** Adjust `mark-opacity` (0-1)
- **Animation:** Set `fragment="false"` to disable reveal animation
- **Positioning:** All positions use viewport percentages (0-100)

{{< hovering-annotation 
  annotation="See the [README](https://github.com/crsh/quarto-hovering-annotation) for complete documentation of all parameters." 
  box-x="20" 
  box-y="80" 
  annotation-width="45%" 
  color="3" 
  fragment="false" 
>}}
